The briefing

You are an elite detective called to investigate the disappearance of Dr. Alistair Vance, a researcher who vanished from an abandoned underground facility. He had been working on a classified ancient energy relic known as Project Resonance.

The moment you step inside, the quarantine protocol fires. Blast doors seal, bulkheads lock and the way back to the surface closes. The building is now a puzzle you have to solve from the inside: read what Vance left behind, open the locks, collect the access items and reach the Ancient Vault before the lockdown becomes permanent.

      Run it on your machine

      The game is a Java desktop application. You need a JDK installed.

      Source code · branch member2-gameplaymehrajvalliya99-lang / Escape-Room-GameOpen on GitHub
      terminal

      # From the project root: compile

      javac -d bin src/*.java src/models/*.java src/screens/*.java

      # Launch

      java -cp bin Main

      Before your first run

      From the home screen choose Start Game, enter a detective name, pick Easy (20 min), Medium (15 min) or Hard (12 min), then enter the facility. Click named objects to inspect them, type answers in puzzle windows, and use Inventory in the lower right. If you are stuck, Hint gives up to three progressive nudges at 25 points each.
